claims.claim: The versioned Post-TASK projection authenticates current TASK identity and reuses Brain Sync and Unified State for lifecycle, action, authority and blocker. FRESH_TASK and admitted ACTIVE remain distinct.

Exact RESULT/FAILURE wake selectors bind canonical terminal artifacts, RUN, TASK revision, head and affinity. Invalid, stale, mismatched or conflicting sources produce typed blocked/unknown projections.
RESULT without independent REVIEW remains SEMANTIC_REVIEW. REVIEW PASS without main inclusion remains pending publication; DONE requires established inclusion.

The projection exposes source-bound candidate, terminal artifact, review-decision and published-source identities using canonical readers and ancestry. Unproven identities remain null with explicit reasons.
FAILURE supplies one exact source-bound terminal_failure_context handoff. Ordinary RESULT and DONE projections require no raw-log crawl and export no protected raw path.

Post-TASK and portable Work Context serialization enforce an 8192-byte bound, redaction, request-scoped witnesses, substitution detection and source-currentness checks. Unavailable or moved sources fail closed.

The maintained Operator post-task caller supports exact TASK and wake inputs, with detached/read-only subprocess fixtures. Provider-neutral Work Context consumes the projection while the existing state command remains intact.

Regression fixtures cover TASK-402 publication, RUN-401-002-shaped dirty FAILURE, fresh/active states and forged, stale, conflicting, incomplete-review and misleading-carrier cases. The repaired RUN-125 fixture uses real disposable commit objects and retains every original assertion. Its targeted 12-worker check exited 0 with -o pythonpath=; the default local invocation reported a package-inventory digest mismatch.

Post-TASK observation preserves existing lifecycle owners and exposes no execution or mutation authority. This clean committed repair changes only the bounded test fixture, retains production cryptographic validation, and directly descends from the supplied failed candidate.
